finalists.label: Hemangiopericytoma
finalists.why: It has the most specific and detailed evidence for it, including a large extra-axial heterogeneous mass and erosion of the inner and outer table of the left frontal bone.

finalists.label: Brain tumor
finalists.why: It is a broad category that fits the general description of the mass, but lacks specific details that would make it a stronger candidate than Hemangiopericytoma.

frontier_selector.why: The evidence of a large extra-axial heterogeneous mass with well-defined lobulated margins and avid enhancement of denser areas, as well as erosion of the inner and outer table of the left frontal bone, specifically supports Hemangiopericytoma over the more general category of Brain tumor.
